Checker exhaustively compares small finite objects and 141 independent normalization identities; it does not replace the infinite argument.

value.rationale: A natural random critical-dimensional linear probe can detect nontrivial homology in a finite chain complex. The entire coupled limit distribution and explicit parity-based first-order convergence obstruction identify a structural observational phenomenon not captured by the known marginal homology law. Exact finite flag counts and limiting formulas enable further study of random homological witnesses without claiming a universal first-order theorem.
